title: Nonlocal intrinsic Harnack estimates
summary: We extend DiBenedetto's intrinsic parabolic Harnack estimates to a class of integro-differential equations with measurable kernels modeled on the fractional $p$-Laplacian. More remarkably, we establish intrinsic, representation type nonlocal estimates and reveal that nonnegative local solutions abide by a strong maximum principle even for $p>2$, a property unique to nonlocal problems. Analogous results hold true for nonlocal equations of porous medium type.
